I’ve been using wipes on my face and decolletage area, as well as on a patch of sunburned skin on my knee. (Random, I know--but I was wearing ripped jeans and now have a silly-looking knee tan like a stripe.) I bought these pads to split between my face and my sad little knee patch. And having swiped the exfoliant on my knee skin daily for almost two months, I can say that there has been literally NO SHIFT whatsoever in the removal of any dead, burned skin cells. Alcohol Denat is the fifth ingredient. This ingredient is terrible for your skin. Bad alcohols (such as alcohol denat) when used in high concentrations in skincare deteriorate your skin’s protective barrier which means your skin is no longer effective at keeping moisture in. It also stimulates oil production which could lead to breakouts if your skin makes too much oil. Although alcohol denat makes the cream feel lighter and dries down more quickly, it’s not worth those pros, at all. Also, this comes in a jar packaging. I still don’t understand why companies do this - not only is it significantly less sanitary, any beneficial ingredients degrade significantly more quickly in a jar so you’re paying for nothing.

This is an effective, gentle and non-stripping gel cleanser. It does produce a light foam, but unlike traditional foaming cleansers that use strong surfactants, this does not strip all the moisture off your skin. I am almost done my first bottle and seriously considering repurchasing. I have combo normal/oily skin and this has never given me a reaction. My skin never feels tight after using this product. I find that half a pump or less is enough to wash my face. A full pump dispenses a bit too much product and is a waste.If you’re relying on this cleanser to remove makeup, you’re simply washing your face wrong, plain and simple. You should always use a first cleanser/remover (whether it’s a balm, micellar water, or cleansing oil) to remove makeup, then follow up with a gentle cleanser such as this for proper cleansing. If you do find a product that can do both...chances are, you’re not going to remove makeup AND properly clean your skin.... making it more likely for breakout-causing bacteria to be left behind. Or, that product is going to be very stripping and bad for your skin.So, if you’re expecting this to remove makeup AND clean your face, please move on. This product isn’t for you. But, if you’re looking for a gentle cleanser as your only step (if you wear little to no makeup), or as a second step, this fits the bill and does the job properly! The light natural scent is refreshing and does not bother me. review_text: I have moderately oily skin and this moisturizer is wonderful for my face in many ways. It is not necessarily oil-controlling (nor does it claim to be), but when used with the right skin care regimen and cosmetic products, I think other combo/oily skinned people will like this product.This moisturizer is very concentrated and hydrating in a good, non-greasy way that keeps my skin fresh and supple, which in turn, reduces sebum production on my face, leaving me less oily looking. You only need a small amount of this product due to its amazing concentration. I use about 1/3 less of this than other moisturizers I have used for my oily skin in the past.To give a better background of my skin and preferences for those of you combo/oily people debating on buying this product: I have mild acne and moderate oiliness. This moisturizer did not break me out or make my existing breakouts worse. I like to wear a full face of makeup, so a good skin care regimen is necessary for my makeup to look good. I use a mattifying primer after this moisturizer before I put my liquid foundation on, and my makeup looks great. I do not get excess oil production.I’m a fan of this moisturizer. It’s lightweight, yet hydrating, not sticky, and balances my facial sebum well. I would definitely recommend.

review_text: I’ve noticed a lot of confusion over whether or not this cleanser is an all-natural product. “Natural“ means different things to different brands. (Cucumber... Slightly. Smell it again and you’ll smell all that rose water that’s listed as the first ingredient). However, this cleanser is not an all-natural product. Some of its ingredients are natural; some, like the various parabens listed near the end of its ingredients list, and BHA and BTA (two synthetic preservatives) are certainly not natural. So no, this is not an all-natural product. It is a product that utilizes SOME great natural ingredients.As far as quality, I have really enjoyed this cleanser. I had been using a completely natural cleanser on my combination skin and started experiencing a lot of sensitivity with dryness and some breakouts. Since using this product (about two and half weeks now), my skin has a glow and softness it had been lacking for months. I haven’t had any breakouts, my pores look smaller, and though it hasn’t been greatly moisturizing, my skin has been significantly less dry.You don’t need much, it removes all make-up (eye make-up included), and has never bothered this contact wearer. The only thing I can think to compare this lip mask to is drugstore vaseline... except maybe (and that’s a strong maybe) a tad bit more moisturizing. If you don’t already know, vaseline has the tendency to create a barrier on your lips that locks moisture in. However, if you have dry lips then this barrier is somewhat pointless as you can no longer get any moisture in. This lip mask is similar to that just with a bit more moisture in its barrier. I’ve been using it nightly for about a week or so and wouldn’t say the results have been life changing. I will say that the fruity smell is really nice and it spreads evenly really well. It actually came with a small silicone applicator that’s perfect for coating your lips in a thin, smooth layer. Personally, I found the results to be better when I used less product while still coating completely as it prevented my lips from having that dry, hard, and pale look in the morning. review_text: I received my order of Good Genes complimentary from Sunday Riley in exchange for my honest review. I had never used a lactic acid before, but I had use other AHA’s in the past. Lactic acid is better for people like myself who have sensitive skin, but still want go chemically exfoliate (which sounds really intense and scary but this product makes it so easy and gentle!). I started out using Good Genes at night time 1 day on 2 days off to get a good sense of how my skin would react. I put it on and went to bed and washed my face like normal in the morning. The first couple of times I used Good Genes my skin tingled a little but it did hurt and the tingling sensation only lasted about 20 seconds. By the third time I used it my skin didn’t get tingly at all! I’m still only using it one day on two days off because I have eczema and I don’t want to overwhelm my skin. I’m 26 years old, have eczema, and REALLY large pores on my chin and cheeks... and bad blackheads on my nose. Or I should say, I used to have! I really am surprised at how quickly Good Genes started working, by my third use I really noticed my cheek pores looking a lot smaller and my chin pores are significantly reduced as well. I don’t think this is specifically a product for black heads, but my nose doesn’t have as many little black dots anymore!!! The other thing I’m noticing is that my face looks a lot less dull. I also use a Vitamin C serum and I think the lactic acid is working well with it, because my old acne scars and some sun spots are really really fading now that I’m using both products. Since I only use Good Genes about 3 times a week I think the bottle will last me around 3-4 months so I’m excited to see the long term difference it makes. What I like the most about this Good Genes lactic acid is that it doesn’t hurt or dry my skin out at all and that’s really important to me because of my eczema.

review_text: The Good:- Has a lovely gel texture - A little really does go a long way, which I was very impressed by - A great summer moisturizer for combo skin - SCENTED, but didn’t irritate my skin. The scent wasn’t over powering either, has a nice fresh scent to it. If you’re going for completely unscented, this may not be it. The Bad- Alcohol Denat is the THIRD ingredient. This is a drying alcohol, which gives products a quick drying finish. It’s not great for the skin barrier, and some studies have suggested that the long term use of drying alcohol in skincare will outweigh any immediate benefits. According to Paulas Choi’s website:“Consequences include dryness, disruption of the surface of skin’s microbiome and barrier (the latter being especially bad for skin), and a strain on how skin replenishes, renews, and rejuvenates itself.”NOW people tend to be pretty split on how negatively alcohol denat is to skins long term health. So for some people this ingredient being so high-up on the list won’t phase them. If that’s the case, then I think this is a great product. If you’re a little more ingredient picky like me, this product would be a pass.

Your experience with the Cicapair treatment will greatly depend on your skin tone and skin type. However, it blends beautifully under my tinted sunscreen. Pros: truly does counteract red tones. A little goes a long way. Does not pill. Cons: Slightly gritty texture. Can emphasize peeling areas. Cannot be worn alone unless you’re pretty light-skinned. Increases T-zone shine if you don’t top with a mattifying setting product. Jar formulation is less stable and hygienic than a tube or pump, so product may spoil faster. Note: in order to *actually* get the full SPF30 protection from this product, you’d have to apply 3-4x more product than is needed for color correcting - and using that amount of product will likely leave you VERY ashy, greasy and sticky. Don’t rely on this alone for sun protection especially if you have photo-sensitized skin from retinol or acids.The bottom line is, this product absolutely color corrects, but it’s far from perfect with serious trade-offs.

review_text: When they were recently forced by European regs to reformulate Good Genes, substituting glycolic for lactic acid, Sunday Riley ALSO reformulated this domestic version: with organic ingredients and a lowered “price point“. The old stuff caused a tingle that was at times a bit uncomfortable but brought great results - this barely feels like anything on.   Not worth it and such a shame!!
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: I bought the mini version with the cleanser and treatment. The first night I tired this product I was absolutely blown away at how clear my skin was, just over night!! My hopes were so high but unfortunately after about a month of nightly use, I find it no longer is producing the same effects, but I do find it has significantly reduced white head and black heads I get. Overall I think this product is worth 4 stars, but for the unnecessary price, 3 stars. I would say give the mini size a try but long term use beware. I think there is definitely cheaper lactic acid treatments out there that will do the same thing.

review_text: I love most of the DE products and I REALLY wanted to love this too. I used it for few months saw no effects so I stopped for a while. Just a little better than if I used nothing. I haven’t seen any anti-aging effects. It didn’t smooth or plump my skin or improve texture. There was almost no noticeable added benefit to justify repurchasing. I have tried other products that I like better. As I am approaching 30, I’m starting to see changes in my skin. I feel that I will need something a little more active than this & I’m ready to replace this with alternatives that will really plump up and hydrate my skin. On the dry areas it really brought them up to a better level and gave them a nice look and glow.For combination skin this is a fantastic cream if you use it as a twice a week moisture boost, or use it daily but only on your normal/dry areas, avoiding those areas prone to oil. review_text: I purchased this, loved it, and purchased a second box. Unfortunately, I will be returning this. I prefer not to use retinol in my skincare because of its debatable safety/toxicity. I was unaware that this contained retinol, until I reviewed all my products while trying to conceive. It’s on me that I didn’t thoroughly review the ingredients in the first place, but it’s disappointing that none of the peels in this line are retinol-free, including the gentle daily peels. I also dislike that the retinol isn’t listed with the active ingredients on their chart comparing ingredients of each level of peels. I know that some people seek products with retinol. In that case, this product delivers the results that it promises, quite intensely. Over time I increased my frequency of use, but if my treatments were more than 3x/week, my skin appeared plastic with a dry shine. I mean mirror SHIIIIINE. But this cleared my pores and the texture across my cheeks beautifully. I’d recommend starting slow and definitely don’t slack on your daily spf.
review_title: Great if you don’t mind RETINOL
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: in the last year  after moving from NYC to a city in a v humid climate, i’ve gone from almost perfect skin with the occasional bout of hormonal acne to good skin with a bumpy (non-acne) forehead. it’s not super noticeable bc pigmentation was even, but the texture upset me. I LOVED my derma in NY, but hate the guy I saw here who looked at my forehead, shrugged, and said only models needed / had better skin than me. He gave me a tretinoin cream which hasn’t helped with either these bumps or my occasional one or two hormonal zits. (seriously, i hate this doctor). Finally one of my friends who is a dermatologist in her residency years looked at my forehead while we were out drinking (i know) and “diagnosed“ me with sebaceous hyperplasia, which has to do with the overproduction of sebum/overgrown sebum glands. The only clinical solution is laser treatments, and if I want to get to perfectly smooth, that’ll be an option, but after a lot of research, I found that niacinamide is supposed to help with sebum production... so I gave this a try. My skin isn’t perfect of course, but WAY better after about 2 weeks of use. For reference: I also use SKII’s essence, The Ordinary’s buffet serum, sometimes glycolic acid toner or M-61 powerglow peel, and a retinol in addition to the rosehip hyaluronic moisutrizer from fresh.
review_title: Visible reduction of non-acne forehead bumps!

I read reviews religiously before buying any product in store but I never take the time to comment, so that’s saying something.I was very hesitant to try this product. I have combination skin that is oily in the t-zone (forehead, nose and chin mostly) and dry on the sides of my face however I break out frequently all over. I’ve used tons of products and I was having a really hard time finding a moisturizer that worked for me. Because of my tendency to break out and my shiny t-zone I laughed at the idea of using pure argan oil on my face. I used oil-free moisturizers only and frequently found that my makeup looked cakey no matter how much moisturizer I applied. I should also mention I use a Clarisonic Mia every day and my cleansing ritual is up to par. I tried switching foundations and nothing seemed to help. Finally, after reading the reviews for this product and finding that other acne-sufferers were using it successfully I bought the sample size of argan oil and gave it a try.Let me say first and foremost that after having tried so many products I know that nothing is perfect, but this moisturizer is close. It glides on beautifully and you don’t need very much to cover your whole face. I have not noticed an increase in breakouts since I began using the product which surprises me. I don’t like that it leaves my face a bit shiny after I apply but when I apply makeup over it, that shine fades into a nice, healthy glow. I’ve even started adding a dab of argan oil to my foundation before applying it with my makeup brushes so it glides and blends more smoothly. The smell of the product is a bit weird, but I have never really cared about that sort of thing and it’s such a mild smell that it is barely worth mentioning. I used it both morning and evening and when I wash my face at the end of the day or first thing in the morning I find it’s smooth and supple. I have been using this product through the winter months so I am not sure how it holds up in humidity or the heat just yet.Overall, an awesome product if you’re looking for moisture retention and a definite option if you have trouble, acne prone skin like myself.

review_text: I’ve literally had acne since I was 14, so long that I don’t know what I look like without it. I’ve tried so many products and this one works well. Definitely helped my skin’s texture, helped decongested my pores and clear a lot of the surface acne. Around weeks 3-4 you’ll notice a lot of acne as your face is purging (look it up!) so don’t feel disappointed. However the purging cleared up and my face only stayed semi-clear even after being religious with my skin care routines plus this product (day and night, spf 50, the whole jazz). I did more research into my skin type (rosacea, very red with acne) and learned that retinol is what is most recommended for acne (don’t worry it’s also an exfoliate!) and niacinamide for scarring and redness. After I started using those my skin is totally clear except for some blackheads, see Week 7. The Inkey List has a great niacinamide serum, or I use The Ordinary’s 100% Niacinamide Powder and mix it with the Marine Hyluronics serum in the morning. At night I use La Roche-Posay’s Retinol B3 serum (B3 is niacinamide) and for extra acne fighting also La Roche-Posay Effaclar Duo Global Action Acne Treatment. If you are to buy one of these products I recommend the last La Roche-Posay product, it’s a cream and has always made my skin better within the same day. The Dr. Dennis Gross peel is good but it is expensive and won’t fully treat your acne if it’s really stubborn. Do some research or watch dermatologist skin care videos. Also, recognize that your skin will never look airbrushed as pores and acne are totally normal. Make changes in your diet and exercise and use products that target your skincare goals and needs of your skin type, I promise it will work! And if you have acne, hang in there!! It’s taken 10 years for me to find what keeps my skin clear and consistent

review_text: I didn’t like this balm at all the first time I used it, but was determined that it would grow on me, so I continued using it for over a month. review_text: First review. I know this gets raves so my two cents is negligible but for what it’s worth, this made me break out horribly. I’m not allergic to anything and maybe it is a fluke, but I’m really disappointed.

review_text: I have dry skin and am in my early thirties so my skin has started to show its first signs of wear. I have been using several brands of moisturizer and decided to try this one because of the mostly positive reviews.It did not work for my skin. I didn’t notice any really big difference in my skin. I live in nyc and found it too stripping for the winter months. product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: I was torn between this and the Oil Control Moisturizer Fresh. I tried a sample of this for about a month, dabbing just a tiny drop on my face morning and night. I do love the smell, the lightweight gel-like yet creamy texture, and the moisturizing properties BUT (and this is a big one) there seems to be an almost flake-like residue after rubbing it in. Even right after a warm shower, when your skin is absorbing everything, I still got that flakey residue left behind. It didn’t break me out or make me super greasy, it actually seemed to calm my crazy skin and the moisture made it feel great, I just cannot get over that residue! It wasn’t oily at all, just.... almost like you can peel it off. Strange. It didn’t bother me at night since I take off all my makeup and just sleep but during the day, I wasn’t feeling it. Will eventually purchase for nighttime wear to complement my day time Oil Control Moisturizer Fresh. The scent is amazing and the texture (before rubbing it on) is lovely. I love all the natural ingredients. The texture after rubbing it? ehhh thumbs down, And the packaging needs a cosmetic spatula or pump bottle. Definitely give it a try though, could be your HG! ;)

I wanted this to work so badly and it did, but unfortunately while I slept it transferred to the skin around my mouth and caused ugly mouth breakouts. Not a good look! If you are not prone to break outs, use this because it works! Live the life I cannot live
review_title: Wish I could keep using it

I have used it during breakouts and as well when I have good skin (no breakouts and moisturized, but have redness). This product is hard to work with for my skin type because it clings onto every dry patch and crevice. It never really sets and glides on my face throughout the day. I honestly don’t want to step out of the house whenever I use this because it looks like I used dry, cheap foundation.
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: This product would probably benefit people with mature skin the most. I’m 20 and it really didn’t help me at all. I did not like the feel of it on my skin but that’s not what I care for in a skincare product. My skin usually loves lactic acid so I assumed this would really benefit me and help with texture. Im not sure what percentage of LA there is in here but I can say that it caused no irritation. If you’re accustomed to AHA you might not notice any great difference with Good Genes. I find that it’s very overpriced. I did like this more than the Luna night oil but honestly I regret purchasing both. The packaging is pretty and this product does work for a lot of people, I just think you can find better for a more affordable price. If you’re young, don’t bother splurging on something this expensive.

Removes all makeup, doesn’t leave your skin feeling dry or oily, and doesn’t irritate my eyes. A little goes a long way.

review_text: These work really well! I already have a pretty involved skin care routine and exfoliate often but after only 2 uses with these, I could tell my skin was brighter and much smoother. They didn’t irritate or cause any dryness.
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: My skin is not too oily or dry, but it is very sensitive and I use a prescription retinol, as well as a bunch of other skin care products, that do tend to dry it out. I also occasionally use a tea tree face wash when I am breaking out from hormonal cystic acne. Otherwise, I use this cleanser twice daily and it NEVER dries my skin out and always helps my skin recover if I’m having a dry/flaky spell. My skin also gets red very easily (even just washing with water) and this doesn’t irritate it any further like other cleansers do. I rarely rate products 5/5 but this deserves it. Smells very vaguely of cucumbers.

Despite this claiming that it has a tiny amount of essential oil/fragrance, once I opened it there was a strong lavender scent. I was unsure to put it on my skin because of the scent, but I put it on anyway to test it out. I like what it did to my skin, it got rid of the redness and made my skin even, but it made my skin tingle and burn because of the lavender essential oil. Essential oils are terrible for your skin, I knew it burned because of it. I don’t normally have sensitive skin, but I washed my face because I didn’t want my skin to break out or have a reaction. I am going to return this and look for an alternative product
review_title: Made my skin burn. Scent too strong
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: So thick and nice for dry/dehydrated skin, but it is just not worth that much money. Had to try given the hype and now it’s going to be a staple for me. Smells great, quick and easy and does what it says it’s supposed to do. Literally melts the makeup off of my face and so gentle!
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: I’m a bit surprised by all the reviews calling this moisturizer lightweight, because in my experience at least for 10-15 minutes after applying it feels like it’s sitting on top of the skin. It almost feels like it’s “suffocating“ the skin, as if it’s been wrapped in saran wrap. It’s quite an odd feeling that I’ve only experienced with heavy body lotions. I have normal to combo skin, so normally use lightweight gel moisturizers like the Cerave PM (though that one can feel too light in the winter). After the lotion absorbs, it does leave a very lovely velvety matte finish to the skin which feels very soft to the touch and not shiny (again, surprised by all the reviews saying this leaves a glow! definitely not my experience). I agree with a reviewer below that the texture of this feels very different than the sample, which felt much more liquidy and light. It may be that the dispenser concentrates the cream and squeezes out too much at once. I have been using half a pump which is more than enough for my face and neck. Overall, I likely won’t repurchase given the price.
review_title: sits on top of skin like saran wrap

Great to remove makeup. I though it felt weird at first, but now I love it. If it gets in your eyes, it doesn’t hurt (I’m stupid and it happens to me a lot when removing eyeliner) it just makes your sight blurry.

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

Finally, it doesn’t do a very good job of removing my makeup.

Not A bad cleanser.. just really dried my skin out. I have oily-sensitive skin btw

if you want a bougie first step cleanser to remove sunscreen than this is perfectly mediocre. i have tried to use this so many times for removing makeup and it fails every time. at first i thought maybe i was using it wrong? but i read the directions and tried it multiple different ways and it just clings to the makeup and won’t come off unless i use a different cleanser multiple times and scrape it off with my finger nails. review_title: Very convenient. Gradually evens out skin tone.

review_text: I have tried many of Youth to the People’s other products and liked them all, so I bought the full size of this assuming I would like it also--and if I didn’t, well, it’s a wash-off product, so I could use it up and then switch to something else with little harm done. Big mistake. My skin is pretty resilient--in fact, I can’t remember the last time a product caused a reaction like this--but the Superfood Cleanser gave me a bad case of contact dermatitis. I had scaly, dry patches above and at the corners of my eyes, my eyes themselves were irritated, and I had an itchy rash on my chin and around my nose. It had to be caused by this product, because I introduced nothing else new to my routine. I have to wonder if some of the people in the reviews who say this broke them out also were suffering from contact dermatitis, since sometimes it looks like little whitehead pimples. After a few days of using cortisone cream, my previous First Aid Beauty cleanser, and Cerave and Skinfix moisturizers, my skin is finally doing better, but I feel far more wary about Youth to the People as a brand now. I normally steer away from fragranced products like those by YTP and am put off by brands attempting to make money by using trendy but meaningless terms like “superfood,“ but I gave their products a try because I appreciated the mostly glass packaging, which is more recyclable than plastic. I will use up the YTP products I already own but will think again before buying more.

Even if I consume lots of water, my lips can still be dry. So I expect a lot out of lip balms. Clearly this works for some people, but I think if you have skin that’s more on the sensitive side, or very dry lips in the first place, look for products that don’t have fragrance or alcohol in them.

I also keep a bottle at the gym. It works as a great light moisturizer during my workout after I’ve washed my makeup off. I’ll definitely repurchase. I’ve been using 4-5 drops morning and night for about a month and I’m a little less than halfway through the 0.5 oz bottle.

I received this sample from PinchMe. My skin is sensitive, so I waited a day in between users. After the second one, I noticed my skin was brighter. Everyday I use spf, I didn’t notice my skin more sensitive.
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: Definitely disappointed in this product. I have dry skin and never have acne. I can count on one hand how many times I break out a year and this product made me breakout with pimples and cyst all over my face and neck. I gave it one month to let my skin Purge and see if anything changes ...it just kept getting worse. I have Never seen my face so dry after using this face wash. The smell I liked because it gave a very clean scent, it does remove makeup and the bottle is nice , this is why I gave it two stars. In my opinion I felt this face wash really stripped the oils from my skin and I do not recommend this face wash. There is definitely better with a much more worth of that price.

Though I’m glad this didn’t dry out my face, it also didn’t seem to do much of anything at all. Had to go back to my old cleanser after a few days as my skin felt clogged. I’m glad I got it as a free gift, as it seems way overpriced for what it is. Smells nice, though. Like cucumbers.

Love love love! I struggled with baaaaad hormonal acne for about a year, and tried so many different products with no luck. But this stuff made SUCH a difference for me! My skin is pretty much totally cleared up now, and I am so happy! I definitely recommend you all try it right now. Even if it doesn’t work for you, it’s such an amazing price, you won’t be losing too much money! Try it, try it now!

Since its been a very cold winter this oil has been great for my dry skin. I add a couple of drops to my foundation. I put it on before my moisturizer. Works on cuticles. And just a drop helps with frizzy hair. A bottle lasts forever. Seems expensive but its a very good bargain because it just takes a drop or two.
This caused me to break out terribly. If you have acne prone skin, beware!

I’ve been using this daily for a few months. It really has moisturized and softened my skin.  It hasn’t done anything for scarring or acne or tone or brightness.  It excellent as an simple hydrating moisturizer. Using it with a serum is necessary. A bit bummed there isn’t spf

I have been dealing with hyper pigmentation since I was 18 and this was a game changer! I have tried everything from Murad to Kiehls but this really did it!You can honest to god see a difference in about 3 days. I will forever use this productMy skin is not only glowing but it is almost a perfectly even complexion ! Only Con: the smell but when a product works this good, the smell is worth it.
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: Caution: If you use this product to take off eye make-up please be careful. This product may over dry your eye skin. For me the dryness left a stingy feeling on my skin. The product does work well on the rest of my face.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: I started using this oil as my moisturizer when I was pregnant with my second baby and my skin was super sensitive. I just had my third baby and used this on my belly everyday....no stretch marks! I even use this on my 4 month old daughter because her skin is super dry. Its very gentle and have found multiple uses for it. Love love!

I bought this product for pigmentation and to hopefully correct my uneven skin tone/sun damaged. First day of use I started to get blemishes and pores on the sides of my face. I supposed it must be my bed sheets or diet, but nothing changed. I’m halfway through the bottle and have been getting horrible breakouts on my face. The center of my face is clear while my cheeks aren’t. Here’s a before and after.
These didn’t do anything for my skin and I used all 35 treatments. I honestly just used them all to finish them. I found the smell to be a bit distracting as well. Save the cash!
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: Used in combination with the Fresh strawberry scrub, I’ve been very happy with how clear my face has been and how much more toned my skin seems. However, the strong cucumber smell is a little bit of a turn off for me, but it’s not bad enough to make me not continue to use it, as long as I continue to see results.
Although this is intended to be a daytime moisturizer, I use Protini as a night cream. It soaks in well (no pillow residue in the AM!) and keeps the skin hydrated on these cold dry evenings.
This item, although many say it’s a dream, has way too many chemicals for me. I like a more natural approach. Korres, 100% pure, etc. It does remove makeup, etc as mentioned.
Nice. Moisturizes behind the lips.  Nice smell.    Don’t know it’s any better than normal chap stick.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I did not like this at all. It doesn’t feel good after, like completely strips the face and I personally felt it made me break out. I never had pimples the way I got with this cleanser. Not worth the price. I only liked the glass bottle.and smell. 2 thumbs down on this one

This review is for the NEW FORMULA. The old formula was amazing!!!! The new one does abbbbsolutely nothing and feels “cheaper”. When I contacted Sunday Riley for information on what exactly in the formula changed, they gave me the run around and never actually explained. Not purchasing ever again.
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: Love this! I’ve just been using the mini size from the birthday gift but I’m very happy with how quickly I got results! I’m lazy with lip products and this sets me up to have moisturized lips all day. Will absolutely buy the full size!
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: Smells like berries. This is a high shine lip product. However, if your lips are very dry this does not help sooth or moisturize them. The ingredients that are good for your lips are very low on the ingredient lists. I’ve used this for months now and mainly use it as a clear lip gloss.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I was going to use 15ml for the hair, but since I have a long hair it was just too pricy to use it for hair. Btw I love the idea of multi-use and etc. :)
review_title: like a miracle oil but toooo expensive.

review_text: I have oily acne prone skin and this stuff works so well! I use it at night right before I go to bed and every morning I wake up my skin looks amazing. I’ve noticed it has helped my acne scars, doesn’t make my skin overly oily, and makes my skin overall look so healthy! Would definitely repurchase over and over again!

I have surrendered to the fact that niacinamide products give me severe acne... I don’t know a lot about skincare, but I know this is a holy grail product for many and was very excited to use it. I have tried using this product (as well as a niacinamide night cream) on and off for 6 months, and without fail, every time I use it (or the cream), I wake up with deep, under the skin acne in places that I have never had pimples before. I see the benefit of it on parts of my skin, but I can’t stand the painful acne it gives me. Not for my skin, for whatever reason!

I’ve be gotten this in deluxe samples several times. Its good. It is way too heavy for me during the warm months but winter is it great to hydrate my skin. Probably won’t buy the full size (because I have several other products I prefer) but it’s nice to have around for intense moisture.

Was hoping all the good reviews were true.. not the case. I’ve been using this product for almost two weeks and I’ve seen no improvement in my skin. I guess my skin went through the “purging period” because I broke out all along my jaw line and chin with horribly painful acne. I don’t mind paying more for skin care but this is seriously disappointing. If anything changes I’ll update my review.
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: If I could give this product a zero I would but I can’t so I will give it a 1 Horribly clings to dry patches and scabs. Turns bright orange on application to skin and you will have orange all over your fingers .. very disappointed will be returning.
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: I’ve never used Sephora store in my life, but decided to subscribe to Sephora play box to try different things. Unless you are a which on Halloween, not sure why you would need this product.
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: This product is just OK. It doesn’t leave my skin super hydrated, but doesn’t make it feel super stripped either, it just doesn’t do much for my skin but the scent is pretty nice
I’ve received this product for free from pinch me and I’m so glad I did. I struggle with oily skin and acne and this peel made my skin so much smoother and younger! I simply love it!
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: I had high hopes for this product but sadly, I don’t get the hype from the other reviews. This feels like regular soap and my face doesn’t feel that cleansed after. Kind of feels like there’s a film left over.

I love this moisturizer. My skin is very temperamental, its dry, oily and i get blemishes. This is one of the only moisturizer that does not irritate my skin. It balances my skin out with nice hydration, but its not too heavy that it feels gross.

I had high hopes since there were many reviews about this cleanser. While I generally stay away from skincare products that have fragrance, I thought it wouldn’t be too bad as it was the last ingredient on the list and had the word “natural”.I found this cleanser to be incredibly drying and made my acne worse. Will not purchase again.
review_title: Do not give into the hype

review_text: Obsessed with this moisturizer! Very hydrating.  I have sensitive and dry skin. I use it in the morning and evening. Great consistency and not sticky at all. Works well under foundation. I told a friend about this moisturizer and we are both a “belif-er“!
It really is ordinary. This product did absolutely nothing for my skin at all. My breakouts have actually gotten worse while using this. Thank goodness it’s inexpensive otherwise I’d be upset.
I’ve used almost two full bottles and no significant changes, for the price I don’t recommended. Way to expensive and not effective. It also causes some purging in the beginning not worth the $100+
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: I’ve gone through 2 bottles of this cleanser which both lasted many months of regular daily use. I went a couple weeks without it and noticed a major difference in my skin. Never again. Such a great simple cleanser that removes makeup and doesn’t dry out skin. I use twice a day with my foreo and have no plans on straying away from this part of my routine anytime soon!
I have sensistive combination/oily skin and cannot live without this!

Everyone around me raves about this cleanser and when I tried it I didn’t understand the hype. It’s a cleanser, does the cleansing. It barely foams and my face feels “okay” clean after using it. Not impressed with the cleanser. If anything I feel like the Origins frothy cleanser gives me a cleaner feel after washing my face compared to this soy cleanser. Can’t speak on the makeup removing aspect but I don’t feel like this cleanser leaves my face particularly thoroughly cleansed and I don’t wear makeup.

This product does what it says, definitely a luxury item for someone who likes to keep everything moisturized. Makes those midnight kisses a little sweeter too. Without proper hydration and appropriate exfoliation, you can’t expect beautiful lips every night. I keep my blistex right next to it for the harsher months.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: It is the best that I’ve tried so far. It has done a lot for me during this winter.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: First off let me just say the apple lime scent truly smells divine, if I could find a perfume of this scent I’d wear it. BUT this lip balm is just OK. Certainly isn’t worth the price imo. I’ve heard rave things from so many people that it really helped their dry lips and I don’t disbelieve. But here’s my thing, my lips are a special kind of dry. I have eczema around my mouth and on my lips sometimes so when they get dried out, they need a lot of love and attention. While I enjoy this product, I certainly wouldn’t repurchase it. It’s not even as helpful as just straight up aquaphor is tbh and I’ve tried this for months. I’ll finish it up which I’m sure will take a good amount of time but honestly, if you are looking for bang for your buck this is far from it. This is cute packaging and scent but an eh product at the end of the day.
review_title: Smells good but that’s about it
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I was really happy when I first bought this because it was comparable to the glow recipe niacinamide but about a week or two into using I noticed it starting pilling. (It didn’t matter how much or little I used, I also waited proper time with each application) I’m not too sure if it just didn’t agree with the products I currently use or if it’s the niacinamide itself.  Sadly will be returning

For years I had used the cetaphil daily face wash and was able to achieve such amazingly clear skin with it. However, once they reformulated the product I found that it had become irritating for my skin causing breakouts, thus starting my search for a new cleanser. With all the good things I had heard about this cleanser I had so much hope but was sadly let down. The sent is quite pleasing and it forms a beautiful lather but those are about the only good things I have to say. This cleanser caused me to beak out in several places I have never gotten blemishes such as my jaw, chin, and across my forehead. This product simply didn’t work for me, nor do I think it’s worth the price tag! (I have normal-oily, blemish prone skin!)

Would NOT recommend! I heard really good things about it so I gave it a shot but had a terrible reaction. I broke out all over my face with these little oily bumps, it dried out and chapped the skin around my eyes and I wound up with a stye!! It would also sting in certain areas.

I’d been using Vaseline as a lip mask every night but wanted something with a little more oomph. Thought a highly rated product designed specifically for lips overnight like this one would be great. Got the trial size.Honestly, I think it actually does a slightly worse job at keeping my lips hydrated than the original Vaseline. I wake up and my lips feel slightly dry, like I didn’t put enough on, even though I tried s l a t h e r i n g my lips with this stuff.Yeah, it’s silkier and smells better than Vaseline, but it’s really not worth it. At least it didn’t break me out...i think. For reference I live in an arid climate and usually struggle with dry lips, though I use chapstick throughout the day.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: i did like this cleanser for awhile. it wasn’t until a couple months ago i noticed my skin was SO dry after using it. it completely strips my skin and makes my face feel tight. i’ve switched to another one now and my skins doing much better. woudnt recommended for that reason.

If you have even slightly oily or pimple-prone skin, STAY CLEAR OF THIS!!! I started using this last summer and a month later my face started breaking out in cystic acne (which I’ve never experienced in my life, only the occasional pimple here and there). I didn’t immediately make the connection, and for 5 months I suffered from painful pimples that have left me with severe pigmentation. Coconut oil takes about a month before you begin to see pimples/clogged pores, so although it may seem fine initially, if you find yourself with unexplained acne, this is the cause! I can only hope this review helps someone avoid the terror I’ve experienced.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: This product is VERY effective in neutralizing redness! I loved using it in place of a foundation to even out my skin tone. However, over the summer I got maybe 2 shades darker and this did not adapt and looked extremely chalky as I got tanner. I would not recommend this product to someone with medium, tan or dark skin. Secondly, I did notice it would start to separate and move around on my face through out the day if I didn’t use a powder over top.
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: Removes makeup well, has a really nice consistency, however I find it leaves a weird film on my eyeballs and makes my vision blurry for a few minutes - so because of that I would not repurchase.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: I really like the smell and the texture but I already have dry skin. Using this product really dried it out despite it saying it’s a gentle cleanser.

I really like how this moisturizer feels- the gel texture soaks nicely into the skin. This would be a great summer moisturizer, but isn’t heavy enough for my combo/dry skin currently. The fragrance is the same across this line- I don’t love it, honestly. If you like gel moisturizer and don’t mind stronger fragrances in your skincare, give it a try.
Removes all makeup, doesn’t leave your skin feeling dry or oily, and doesn’t irritate my eyes. A little goes a long way.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: I can barely stand to use this product as it sort of just sits on my face - when I try to massage it in using my face massager, it generates a foam.  When it dries, it tends to flake.  Fortunately, only a $6 setback, hence the two stars.

This is sticky, burns if my skin is even slightly dry, and causes breakouts. Doesn’t wear nicely under makeup either. I stopped using it for a few months, tried it again today and it only took a few hours to make the breakout actually worse. Glad it’s inexpensive.

I’m 68 and noticing how dull my skin looks. I bought Good Genes and have only used it for a week and my skin is actually glowing! I’ll always use this now. I’m going to buy more Sunday Riley products.
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: I had high hopes for this cleanser after reading many of the reviews but I am totally underwhelmed. I have normal to dry skin and get occ breakouts around the time of my period. First of all- the cucumber smell is soo strong and almost nauseating to me. I generally don’t mind the smell of cucumber but this is just way too much. Secondly- it does not fully remove my makeup. I wear a very thin layer of foundation and one coat of mascara and there was still plenty to remove after cleansing with this. It doesn’t foam up too much when washing, so if you prefer a foamier cleanser, this probably is not the product for you. I will say it did not cause my skin to breakout, but I’m not sure it helped the hormonal acne around my chin. This may work well for people who have sensitive skin, but really this does nothing special for me. Will not be repurchasing.
This doesn’t do anything for my lips that a thick lip balm hasn’t, but I’ll keep using it!  It’s a nice velvety feel which I like.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: Bought a small sample bottle… smells like grass! It made me break out a little. I don’t try to eat my cleansers but when I clean around my mouth I often taste them, and this was very unpleasant… also really really burns your eyes. I didn’t feel very clean after using this twice a day for a week. But the smell was honestly the worst…

I started using this a month and a half ago and the results are so promising! I used to get pimples now and then on my cheeks as well as jawline and chin, but this product literally makes my skin so soft and glowing! My pimples are gone and my pores look significantly smaller. A little goes a long way
review_title: Can't go without this product anymore!

review_text: Do not use this product on your hair. It made my hair stringy and clumpy. I’ve been using oil on my face for years, and this oil does not provide lasting hydration. I probably will not buy it again.
review_title: This product does not amaze me

review_text: I received this as a sample for my last order seeing how it was recommended for oily skin, and I am OBSESSED! I am the worst kind if person who pretty much hates spending money on skincare (I know >_<) but i will certainly be purchasing a standard size of this moisturizer. Most moisturizer leave my skin with a layer of oil upon waking up the following morning but I never get this with this product. I am normally oily but during the winter my nose will get a little dry and peel-y.

I honestly really like this product, it smells amazing, works well and washes off easily. My only complaint is that it contains polyethylene which can be harmful not to my skin but to marine wildlife when it goes down the drain. At least that’s what I’ve heard.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: I love love love using Cicapair!!! I first received it in a sample and as soon as that sample was gone I immediately bought the full size! It’s perfect for my no makeup days. Not greasy, color correcting (I have light neutral/gold skin), and doesn’t require me to powder my face since it’s already pretty matte. The only real issues I have with it is that it’s a bit thick (I fix that by mixing it with the tiger grass serum to thin it out) and it is a bit drying (this review is made in the winter if that gives any indication). It’s a simple spf that makes me feel good about how I look on natural days (and that i’m protected from the sun!)
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: Melts my make up away. Love it. Will buy the full size when I run out.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: I wanted to love this product since it has so many good ratings, however it was a flop for me. I have combination skin, but on the dryer side of that spectrum. I also have very sensitive skin. I was automatically concerned when I first opened the jar because it just has a strange chemical smell, not necessarily unpleasant to smell, but definitely chemically. I’ve found any product with strong smells doesn’t work well with sensitive skin. I’ve never been prone to breakouts, but I got the worst breakouts of my life with this moisturizer, primarily on my chin. They weren’t normal breakouts either, but large puss filled pimples like I’ve never had before. I will not be purchasing again. It’s also not that moisturizing. My face still felt dry after use.
I was so amazed how it just blended out to skin color it felt great and looked great as well definitely going to buy so glad I got to try for free!
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: Love the product, hate the packaging. The packaging feels heavy so you think you’re getting a lot of product, right? Wrong. The sides of the container are basically a paperweight- solid plastic. So when you purchase this keep in mind that all you are getting is what you see in the aerial view of this photo, not the whole container like the side view shows. I’d say this lasted me as long as the sample size did (this is only 25ml) . Bummer too, because the moisturizer really works.

A sephora employee recommended me this when I told her I have acne scars, redness, and pores. I decided to give it a try. I use it daily every morning and every night. I tried it out for a month and it worked but when the second month rolled around, it didn’t work for me anymore. Instead, it gave me more breakouts and made my skin really itchy. I have sensitive combination skin. I actually have to double cleanse with a different cleanser because this cleanser just from 1 wash actually doesn’t remove any of my makeup at all and it still leaves a lot of residue. I don’t recommend buying this cleanser because it’s more of a cleanser you can use if you need a wakeup call if you’re pulling an all-nighter. It only leaves the face refreshed for like a few minutes and that feeling disappears. It didn’t really soak into my face but instead laid flat on the surface and then disappear.

I have lots of redness and this generally provides a nice natural finish. I don’t prefer it under makeup it gets a little candy, but I like it alone. My first purchase was great, then I bought it again and it’s very watery. I have stirred it and it immediately separates. I’m not sure if they changed the formula, but I find myself not using it and may not refill if I run out.
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: OMG!  I now cannot live without this stuff!  On the nights that I forget to apply, I can definitely notice the difference!   When I use this, the next day I could go without chapstick all day and my lips aren’t the least bit chapped.  When I forget the apply, the next day my lips are parched and am in constant need of chapstick. My HG!
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I bought the... I guess it’s the discovery set(?) and with it came the milk, the tinted spf moisturizer, and the cleansing oil, now, I’ve only used the oil one time in the morning after I cleansed with the Argan cleanser and I only used like 3 drops for my neck and face and its-as-we-speak- sitting on the surface of my skin. This oil is SUPER filtered and processed. I understand that it has to be filtered because of the muck that can build up but this is honestly disappointing.

I recieved a sample of this product from Sephora and used it only when I ran out of my regular makeup remover. I was so impressed with it that I now have added it to my daily routine and replaced my old makeup remover.
review_title: Got a sample... Bought the product!

Glad to say I’ve used this product with no problems yet and it definitely evens out my skin tone, although I do wish it covered my dark spots more. My only complaint is if you’re not light-skinned (I’m very tan), there is a high chance this could look a bit ashy on you :(
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: I don’t feel these samples have enough product to see a diffrence on my skin.

review_text: A gentle cleanser that does the job, however, is not all that impressive. The smell is a bit off putting and while my skin felt soft, other cleansers have worked better.

I liked that they had a value size and they encouraged reusing the same bottle, the lather was nice, the scent (if you like that type of thing) could only be described as clean veggies.Sensitive skin peeps just be cautious before buying, my rosacea was not a fan.
review_title: Wasn’t for me— sensitive skin peeps be aware

review_text: I am not sure this product does much but I have seen less pimples on my face. I love the packaging tho.

Although it tastes good and feels really smooth on the lips, for me it hasn’t been a game changer. My lips are ter-ri-ble as a side effect of my Accutane treatment, and this product is not the one to mitigate the problem.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: Kind of irritates my skin, unfortunately. I’ve heard so many good things about Argan oil, I wanted to try it. I may use it on other parts of my body other than my face.

One one hand, it does cancel out the redness that I have from my rosacea, and just being a very pale, pink faced person, and it does glide on smoothly which helps with the appearance of pores. But that’s where the positives end. It’s a very difficult product to work with. If I wear sunscreen underneath (which you should, this is NOT a standalone spf), the Cicapair CC Treatment either sits on top like a slick greasy mess or just flakes off. If you wear any makeup on top, since this reeeeealy makes your skin look one dimensional and lifeless, all of my makeup applies very patchy and pills. I’ve tried using the barest amount of this product, tried different makeup application methods like brush vs. fingers vs. BB sponge… nothing works. Tried different foundations, blushes, contours, and spfs- nothing works there either. On top of that, now I’m getting dry flaky patches on my chin and mouth area even though nothing else in my skin care regimen has changed and I’m still using a moisturizer. It looked good in the store, and I tried to make this work, but it’s going back
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: I tried this moisturizer in a mini size in a set; The texture is gel and lightweight, however, it got super oily on my T-zone especially my forehead even though I have combination skin not to oily the few times that I used it which I really didn’t like. I also didn’t like the smell personally; it smells kind of like a mixture of mint and rose water. I didn’t feel so moisturized nor plumped/glowy.

I know a lot of people really like this product but it was an average lip balm for me. It smells really great and there’s a good amount in the jar...but it was not hydrating enough for me. In fact, I think it may have dried my lips out more...but I have very dry lips so I am probably the exception here.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: Wanted it to work for me but I think my skin is too sensitive. Feels like I’m using dish soap on my face and started breaking out. RIP
