This is perhaps the best daily moisturizer I’ve tried for dry skin. I use it with other products for best results, including Korres Wild RoseBrightening Sleeping Facial and Josie Maran Argon Oil. (I have very dry skin!) The combination of products has given me the best results I’ve ever had. I tend to tire of products quickly, but I know that this one will not be going anywhere anytime soon in my routine. I’m on my 4th or 5th jar.

my lips were pretty fine before using this product. never really had issues was just looking for something different to moisturize my lips. i ised this product one time before i went to bed. woke up and as soon as i opened my.mouth the sides of my lips split worse than ever before. it took almost a month to get my lips back to normal. VERY disappointed, even though there ARE mixed reviews about it i decided to gove it a shot. NEVER EVER again
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I used the entire product over a period of about a year. It’s not a bad moisturizer. It works pretty well. Has consistency of most body lotions. No obnoxious smell. The actual moisture provided was decent, nothing to write home about. My favorite thing about Protini is the container which provides a nice little mixing surface for adding other products.
smells nice. dried my skin out and I broke out.
This product does contain all the good healthy stuff but as someone who has acne prone skin it didn’t do anything for me.
I love this so much! It’s very hydrating. It’s a lovely product and melts your makeup right off!
review_title: Hydrating and melts makeup right off
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: Nothing special about this moisturizer, just like any other ordinary moisturizers. Did not do any wonder on my skin and is very pricey
Recieved it as bday present. The texture reminds me of fresh rose deep hydration face cream but without the rose scent . Been using for quite some time, feels nice on skin but does nothing on me.

I bought this product to help moisture my skin in the harsh winter weather - it is moisturizing but wasn’t good enough. It often felt like it sat on the surface rather than sink in. I have combination/ normal skin that gets dry in winter and this helped some, but not enough. It also has the thick consistency of body lotion which worries me, as I have acne-prone skin. So far no breakouts but I will continue searching for a reasonably priced intensive moisturizer.
It is not greasy but makes your skin feel soft. I wear it alone or under my make up. One of the best I have used for daily use.

I like the ingredients and texture of this lightweight balm, but it really didn’t wash away waterproof/water-resistant mascara, eyeliner, etc. I was surprised by how ineffective it was. But as a regular cleansing balm I like it. It’s gentle and makes your skin feel soft afterwards.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: I think this cleanser is just fine. I received it as part of my 2016 birthday gift (waited a while to review, I know), and it’s good to bring on vacations, but it’s not doing much heavy lifting. Scent is nice.

The whole ‘mask’ thing is misleading. There’s nothing special about it. This stuff is basically Vaseline. It is nice as a lip balm, but your fav drugstore product is probably better. Save your coin fam.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: This is the best lip treatment ever!!! if you are looking for a hydrating lip use this you will get the results you want! It is a sleeping mask but I use it during the day too and I get so many complements about how smooth my lips look! anyways get this it is worth the 20$.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I receive this sample product my opinion it’s ok for people who don’t have oily skin. Your result will take a while.
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: I wanted this to work so bad. The reviews were pretty good, but it just wasn’t a match for me. I have some redness - nothing crazy - on my nose along with combination skin. My nose gets dry/flaky and this only emphasized that. Even when my skin wasn’t showing symptoms of dryness, it would immediately look almost like I rubbed clay or chalk over a mild, peeling sunburn or something.
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: I received a sample of this and absolutely loved it. I planned on purchasing it, until I saw the cheap, wasteful packaging. I expected more from such a well respected clean beauty brand. Especially one that is known to use glass containers for other products. Consumers expect a high end, clean item to take its packaging and its impact into consideration. I deducted a star for this reason and also decided not to purchase the item.
review_title: Loved the product, Disappointed in the packaging
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: Okay, let’s get this out of the way: this is not my favorite. I want it to be, but it is not. It does not leave my skin feeling tight. It has a nice gel-like consistency. It smells lovely (like soy). I just feel as though it does nothing good nor bad for my skin. So I can slide either way on the love it hate it wheel. It’s just kind of “meh“ for me. It’s good. I’ll use it. But it is not my favorite. And I won’t repurchase.

Love love this product, well all FIRST AID BEAUTY products. I went to Sephora looking for an item that will hydrate my skin after getting a bad allergic reaction from another product that made my whole face really dry. My face is also very sensitive so with this product I hit the jackpot! It worked less than a week to put my face back to how it used to be, and added more hydration. I also use this for my travels (travel size of course), and I work at the ER department where they also keep room temps really cold which tends to also dry my face and again I use this product to give my skin hydration.
It makes your skin dry and causes breakouts.  I don’t know why ppl rave about this cleanser.

I don’t really understand all the hype about this cleanser. It’s a decent daily cleanser. The gel texture is very soothing and your skin does not feel stripped of its natural oils afterwards. For me, this cleanser was rather unsuccessful in removing makeup, especially around the eyes (I use the bobbi brown gel liner and then set it with an eyeshadow, occasionally I wear mascara). So I have to use an eye makeup remover prior to washing my face. One thing that really bothers me is the smell! I don’t know why, but to me, this smells like a junior chicken sandwich from mcdonalds (or rather the lettuce in it...) hahahaha
I thought this product was great! It was a great moisturizer that I didn’t find to be too greasy! My skin felt amazing!
This balm is literally amazing, this alone takes off 90 percent of my makeup and does it much more gently than makeup wipes. Definitely worth every dollar!
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: I don’t know how I didn’t realize this product had alcohol denat in the top 5 ingredients before I purchased it. I gave it 3 stars because I’m sure it will work for some, but I must have forgotten to take note of that when picking what product to try next.
I’ve been using this cream for months now in the morning! My skin looks great and hidrates it so much! Love this product!

I really really liked this product when I first started using it - the texture is really nice and smooth, as if it had silicone (but it doesn’t!). It’s also somehow both very light weight like a gel, but rich and moisturizing at the same time. I have drier skin and I found this perfectly moisturizing, and it worked fine under my sunscreen. Unfortunately after 2 weeks of use my skin was covered in clogged pores and pustules. I took a break from the product and it cleared up, but I loved the feel of it so much I tried it again (and broke out again).
review_title: Nice texture but broke me out

review_text: I hatted it, it made me REALLY dry. I have sensitive skin which doesn’t really like anything other then simple products. But a couple of hours after I put it on, my face was dry and oily at the same time. The main spots I put it on became really oily, then the rest became really dry.

I don’t know which of its 60 ingredients works but it really does. Previously used Lanolin and this just penetrates more effectively and leaves my lips incredibly moisturized and hydrated in the AM. They feel more plump and incredibly smooth. High recommended.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I received a deluxe sample of this in my play box, and the first thing I noticed was the repulsive scent! I used this in conjunction with other products as I have oily,combo,acne prone skin. But I felt it left a filmy type of residue on my skin and I didn’t like that at all. However it did counteract the drying effects of my acne wash. Overall I just think it needs some improvements to the formula.
Do not understand the benefit of this product.  Product irritated my skin. Caused a tingling sensation on my face so I stop using it immediately
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: This cleanser was alright and I will continue to use it but I got some little bumps on my face and I can not get over the smell ! Personally the smell makes me kind of want to gag, but if you are good with that hole cucumber soy smell then you will love it. ❤️ Love the ingredients.

I was expecting great things from this face wash as I had heard so many good things about it, I bought the travel size because I didnt want to spend $40 on a face wash and I consider even the $9 i spent on the travel sized one to be a waste of money, this product was a major let down. The cleanser itself was so runny I could barely transfter it from my hands to my face before it dripped into the sink, once it was on my face it just ran off, I had the hardest time actually keeping on my skin instead of running off of me into the sink, as for cleansing eye makeup, yes you can use it around your eye without a burn, however after washing my face and looking in the mirror closely I could still notice the shimmer from my eyeshadow around my eye area and I found myself still having to use makeup remover. The product did not lather at all and again was extremely difficult to apply. I would never buy this again nor recommend it to anyone, a waste of money.
review_title: a waste of money and extreme let down

review_text: After reading such glowing reviews, I had pretty high expectations and this was a big “meh.”  It’s a waxy, pleasantly scented lip balm. The container is hefty, you get a lot of product, but since it’s a tub and not a tube, you’ll be digging it out with the included applicator, or once it’s lost, your finger. This would all be okay-ish if it didn’t put itself out as a “mask”.  Although it is moisturizing, I don’t find myself using any less balm during the day or not needing to scrub and exfoliate.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I got this from the beauty insider birthday gift. It really is a gentle cleanser and doesn’t leave my face feeling dry afterwards. Instead, my face feels quite soft after using the product. However, theres a cucumber-like scent but its tolerable and i don’t smell any of it after i rinse it off.
My face felt clean after use. Not overly dry or tough.. It smelled good and didn’t burn when I accidentally got some in my eye!

I bought this product because the sale associate told me it doubles as a makeup remover. I’d say it works just not great. I fine myself having to either wash twice or take off majority of my makeup beforehand.

Not that great. I got the 6oz one, it says “intense hydration“ but I found myself using it again and again after every couple of hours. I used this for about a month and saw little tiny bumps on my skin everywhere especially on my forehead which I did not have before, as soon as I stopped using it in a matter of days my skin was back to normal. Just because it was expensive I want to make use of it so I might use it as a body lotion but I am scared I will get bumpy skin everywhere else. I don’t know what I’m going to do with this smh!! No good things came out of this

I got this oil as a sample.  I have been using Tarte’s Maracuja Oil so wanted to see how this compared. I have only used it for two nights (just under my eyes for now to work on my fine lines) but I’ve already noticed a difference.  My under eye area is much brighter and the lines are becoming less noticeable.  I’ve also been applying it to my lips twice a day and it feels amazing-slowly sinks in to leave my lips moisturized. I am super impressed and will be purchasing a full size bottle. Highly recommended!

I don’t understand why everyone raves about this for redness.  Every time I am in Sephora and complain about redness, they try to sell me on this stuff. It. doesn’t. work. It MIGHT work if your natural complexion is extremely pale, but this did not look natural on my complexion.
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: Just left my skin feeling blah! Did nothing extraordinary that a drugstore bought cleanser could not do. A little expensive.

Received a small sample with purchase. I love the thick nourishing texture and the smell is delightful! I used this product while I was taking Accutane and found that nothing (including this) helped my lips quite like aquaphor ointment. I’d wake up in the morning with dry lips and not a hint of the lip mask on but when I used aquaphor my lips were noticeably less chapped. Would love to try the product again now that I’m off Accutane because the texture and scent are so delightful.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: The smell of this lip mask is amazing. I also think it has a nice texture. However I’m not sure it is doing much for my lips other than maintain the moisture I already have. The instructions say to put on a heavy layer and rinse off the excess in the morning but no matter how much I put on I never find any left in the morning. If you already have nice lips this will definitely maintain but I’m not sure it would help to heal or add much to your lips.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I really don’t love this moisturizer. I have combo skin with acne scarring on my cheeks and my skin just wouldn’t absorb this moisturizer in some areas at all and my skin would be super dry in others. I ended up mixing this with jojoba oil and I use it for my neck and chest now.

I really like this cleanser. It leaves my skin feeling fresh but not too stripped, I have dry skin so I don’t need all my skins oils stripped from my face!! It hasn’t caused me to break out or anything. It’s a nice gel like consistency. I like it, but it’s not anything spectacular.
Took off ALL my makeup, even hard to get eye makeup.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: This had amazing reviews and the sales person highly recommended it so I bought two. I had to return it immediately! It’s way too watery, it’s not moisturizing at all. I also wasn’t a fan of the scent.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I heard so many great things about this, and i wanted to love it so badly! However, I have oily skin. This never absorbed into my skin, but instead produced more oil. If I put foundation on top of it, in an hour its literally like slicked off my face. (yuck) I only use it at night now because i still really really want to like it but Ive almost given up hope.

I use this before going to sleep and I wake up with fresh lips. I have pretty dry lips and this helps a ton, if use consistently. I’m bad at that so I use it about 4 times a week, a little goes a long way. Also come with a mini spatula.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: It does not remove make-up. After every wash, I still have black residue around my eyes, lashes and lips. None of it is waterproof make-up either. Don’t waste your money. There are plenty of other clean and vegan face washes that actually, you know, WASH.
Feels good but no result.
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: I tried many balms and oil cleansers. I was sold by the “green-ness“ of it, but it is the worst of all the make up removers. It clogs my skin and gives me milia. I stopped using it, and I feel my skin getting better already. I have 1/2 jar left, I will eventually hate pan it, but I would not recommend or repurchase.
review_title: Creates a lot of texture on my skin :(
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: There’s so much hype for this product and it did nothing for me. In fact, it may have made my lips more dry. Super bummed.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: Extra-Strength? My skin did not even tingle using this let alone deliver any kind of “peel.“ Treat breakouts? Nope. In fact, it made me breakout. I know that everyone has different skin but this is the worst peel product I have tried. I give this NO stars but in order to add this review I had to choose one star.
review_title: Horrible! Surprised at all the good reviews
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: I’ve been using for a couple months now and it seems great when you first apply however I’ve seen no improvement in the long run. Luis are still dry and peeling.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I’m confused how this product is supposed to be used. I got this as a sample (in exchange for insider points). I thought it was more like a spot treatment thing but I guess it’s not.But like others say, this cream is green and once you put on your skin, it changes to beige/brown. So it’s more like a concealer you put only in the morning??For daily use, I don’t like it. It doesn’t feel good on my skin, dry, and also comes off easily and so flakey.BUT it did fix my acne scar in 1-2 days. So I’d wanna use it at night before I sleep, but I can’t do that because this thing has color to it. Maybe I’ll need to look into other Cicapair product...
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: Skin does not feel clean afterwards. My face feels slimy and oily after.

Many of the reviewers on here said this made them brake out. Since I have more mature skin I didn’t think it would apply to me, but it did! I even tried it for an entire month just to make sure it was this product and not something else.
This is by far one of my favorite products I have ever purchased from Sephora..... Beyond amazing.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: Amazing. LOVE this cleanser. So easy to apply and it wipes every make up from the face, eyes, lips. LOVE IT.I love the fact that you apply it in the dry skin and then wash it off.
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Removing Cleansing Balm

review_text: I got a tiny sample size some time before and used it for tattoos. Years later I needed a facial moisturizer and heard recommendations for this so I figured why not, I liked it before! It is very moisturizing I’ll give it that. However not what I look for in a moisturizer in the morning before my makeup routine. I tried different ways to apply and waited before applying etc but it still pills on me to no avail! Tried to use less product, more product, waited different time intervals between this product and my sunscreen and makeup. Oh well. Still great for the rest of my body I guess so it won’t go to waste.

The second ingredient in the peel is Alcohol Denat. (SD Alcohol 40-B). Shame on me for not reading the ingredients. When l opened the packet it wreaked of alcohol. I tried it anyway because the darn stuff is so expensive. Dried my skin right up as that’s what alcohol denat. does. This ingredient should not be used on skin IMO. I can’t believe a good doctor (if he really is) would use it especially as the second ingredient. Also water acts as a neutralizer so the second packet really isn’t necessary. It’s really just baking soda. I don’t trust this guy and won’t be buying any of his products.
product_name: Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel Pads

review_text: I just couldn’t manage to wear this (by itself or with the other Dr Jart products) without my skin turning into an oil slick, which was totally shocking because my skin is dry. Even though I do get redness around my nose, the color correction kind of made my face look a little ghostly/sickly. I use green tinted primers with no issue.
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: On my second bottle. I have learned to use less and have the bottle last longer. Use instead of moisturizer on warm days. Smells divine.
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: Been using this product for over a month. My skin has been way more itchy after using the product, it also makes more itchy bumps appear under my jawline. Not only that it makes my pores disappear after usage and leaves a very tacky feeling. But it completely does nothing for me. I have combination skin so some parts of my face are oily, dry, and I have alot of dark spots.
I accidentally bought this when I wanted the moisture bomb.  I returned it after trying it for 2 days because it immediately made me feel greasy and break out.  I didn’t feel moisturized.

This product is amazing! I truly love it, I use it when I am washing my face. I use it after I washed my face with my Clean and Clear night time face wash, I mostly use it on my eyes since this is the only product that I can use to clean off my eyes and they won’t get irritated. I would recommend this to anyone!
I love the product but the bottle leaks like crazy
Rave about this product so much. Its a great product. Makes your skin look and feel plump and healthy. Gives so much moisture.

Really wanted to like this, but it did not make my dry lips feel less dry other than when it first goes on. I liked the smell and the little applicator tool it comes with was handy for applying and keeping the product clean. Am still looking for something that will keep my dry lips hydrated throughout the day.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: This lip mask felt good and hydrating right after applying but by the morning I actually woke up and my lips felt drier. Disappointed as it seems to work for lots of people but perhaps I’m the outlier.
review_title: Did the opposite for me. Drier lips by morning!
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: Just not a fan. This is very over priced and doesn’t do anything that something from a drugstore for a fraction of the price wouldnt. I returned this just because it was too expensive to not be great.
review_title: too expensive to not be great
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: this is a good deep cleanse for normal to oily skin, it was a bit drying for my dry skin but its still very good.

My skin gets really dry in the winter so I gave this a try, but with every use it gave me more acne. I stopped for a week and my skin was clearing up. Gave it another try for a few days and the bumps came right back. It is very moisturizing but also somehow makes my skin look dull.

Did nothing for my acne . I bought this cleanser because people where saying it has really good ingredients and I thought I should try it out. I’ve been using it for a few months now and it does nothing for my pores. But the only thing good about it is that it smells good

This a truly mediocre, overrated, and overpriced cleanser. It gets the job of cleaning the skin from impurities just fine, but there is nothing about this that stands out texturally or sensorially. The only thing I can think of that is memorable about this is that it’s drying and stripping. Other than that, it feels like a million other gel cleansers out there. Also, since this is a wash-off product that probably won’t be on your skin for even a minute, you can forget about getting any benefits from the supposed vitamins and whatnot that’s included in the formula. None of that stuff is going to have time to be absorbed into your skin. This isn’t a BAD product, but it’s not as good as it’s hyped up to be.

I was super excited to try out this product, but unfortunately this was not a great match for my skin type. When the green pigment changes to match my skin, it makes me appear grey and chalky. Additionally, it often seems to rub off the more I try to rub it into my skin. Potentially a better SPF solution for skin that isn’t as dry as mine.
review_title: Not a great match for my skin
product_name: Cicapair Tiger Grass Color Correcting Treatment SPF 30

review_text: good price good quality, MUST BUY ! super hydrating, you can use it from head to toe, same quality with those branded moisturizers.
I like this moisturizer for my very dry skin. Especially in the winter time

I’m a lip balm junkie and had to to try this after seeing so many reviews.This feels really nice on my lips but overall it’s not that impressive. It seems to wear off pretty quick and is much thinner than I expected. It works nice under liquid lipsticks. It doesn’t keep my lips moisturized all night at all. I wouldn’t repurchase.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I wear LOTS OF MAKEUP!! And this cleanser, not only takes the makeup off, its gentle!! I don’t use it as a daily cleanser, but when I apply makeup, this cleanser is the best!!! Ironically, I got this as a sample and started using it!!! All that to say, don’t take the samples “lightly“!!!

The sample packet was super strong and potent, I saw and felt results. Then I went and tried the full size version at my friends house and it was totally watered down and weak. I didn’t feel or see any difference. Not the smallest change. It was so disappointing. It might be true what other people are writing about that they changed the formula. To think I was about to purchase this... please bring back the old formula!!!
product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment

review_text: Overall, this seems like a really solid product. I just got it and so far am very pleased with my results. After using, my face feels clean which was a concern originally. I have been a long-time ProActive user and was worried about switching to this. However, I have found this Soy Face Cleanser to be incredibly gentle and effective! I love that I can use it to remove my mascara and eye makeup! I’m not crazy about the smell but it sure is effective!
This doesn’t do anything differently than applying chapstick at night does. Although it smells nice, it’s super sticky and doesn’t last long. I won’t be repurchasing.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: This used to be one of my favorite products, but something has changed and it smells horrible.  I actually exchanged a bottle because when I opened it, I assumed it had gone rancid.  When I opened the replacement at home, it smelled just as bad, though!  Really disappointing.

I think there are better lip masks out there. This one often drys my lips out rather than hydrating them overnight. I’d rather just put a good layer of lip balm on before sleeping and that usually works better than this lip mask.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I did not find this particularly moisturizing.
Tried 3 times and each time I had blurry vision for about 15 minutes. Unfortunately still looking for the perfect makeup remover.
review_title: Blurry vision makes this promising product a no-go
product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo

review_text: This sadly did not do much for my lips. I would put it on at night and in the morning my lips would feel dry. If I wore it throughout the day my lips would dry out very quickly and even peel.
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: This product seems OK, but not worth the hype surrounding it as the “best product“ for everything. Don’t expect that it will replace everything else.

As someone with dry/sensitive skin, this cleanser is ok but maybe not the best for those with irritated skin. I love how it’s a low-foam formulation and actually feels nourishing on the skin. Only bummer is my skin (that’s already sensitive) feeling some burning with the face wash. It doesn’t burn the eyes though, so that’s a huge plus!! Immediately after using, it was a little red but it didn’t feel dry at all, great for us dry skin folk! I didn’t notice any radiance or immediate smoothness after using. So far, I have incorporated it into my routine as a morning cleanser when my skin needs extra nourishment. It’s not great at removing makeup but as a morning cleanse or second cleanse, it’s great and gentle. Warning though, if your skin is experiencing some irritation from other sources, avoid using this product until the irritation goes away. I’m thinking it’s the fragrance that’s irritating my skin. Also, I received this product for free for testing purposes.
review_title: Great for dry skin but for sensitive skin, read on

review_text: I don’t know if its just my really sensitive skin, but every time I tried this to help with the dryness, the next day I would get small bumps (like clogged pores)I am really fair, 22 and I never really had a problem with my skin being too sensitive.I did give this 3 stars because I do use it on my hair and its good, nice smooth oil helps to keep my hair shinny and silky but as far as a moisturizer for my face, not so much.

Such an amazing year-round cleanser! Does an amazing job at removing sunscreen without stripping the skin. The formula is a little interesting but it gets the job done. I use one pump on damp skin. After 30 seconds, I re-wet my hands and continue to wash my face. I noticed a huge difference in my skin when using it like this. I think it helps with brightening the skin as well.
review_title: Amazing Cleanser for Dry Acne Prone Skin.

review_text: Bought the Original lip mask along with the Berry lip glowy balm during the summer bonus event. I was so excited to finally buy the lip mask, I was so excited I thought of buying a backup. Glad I didn’t. The mask smells good, Berry flavored. You get a lot of product for $20, this should last me about a year. As far as my lips go, my lips are chapped or cracked, but during the colder months, my lips get dry
product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C

review_text: I was in the process of healing my acne scars and just wanted to try something to maybe help out in the process of making my skin healthier and brighter, I tried this woke up the next morning with 5 painful bumps that are clustered on both sides of my cheeks that soon grew into big painful zits, and they kept adding until my cheeks were full of new pimples. review_text: I received this product for complimentary from Sunday Riley. let’s talk about the cult classic chemical exfoliant from @sundayriley , Good Genes! This is a cream, lactic acid-based exfoliant that claims to clarify, smooth, and retexturize the skin. In addition to the 5% lactic acid, it contains licorice root extract for brightening, squalane and silicones to moisturize and reduce irritation, various botanical extracts, and lemongrass extract which allegedly helps with brightening, but to me just gives it a nice fragrance. I typically use glycolic-acid based chemical exfoliants (solely for the reason that the Paula’s Choice AHA is my go-to), but lactic acid is a larger molecule and thus has a lower chance of causing irritation.I’ve been using this bottle for about a week now, and have previously gone through a full sample size that I had purchased myself. I have to say, I really enjoy this stuff. It’s a very light lotion-texture with a pleasantly herbal, lemongrass scent. I find that it really brightens and smooths my complexion without drying out my skin. It definitely reduces the appearance of my sebaceous filaments and thus the “pores” on my cheeks. I don’t personally believe that chemical exfoliation is the best way to combat fine-lines, but that is a claim that SR makes about the product. Overall, I would say that this is a nice AHA exfoliant, but I think there are definitely similar products out there for a fraction of the price!

review_text: I initially fell in love with this product and re-purchased a full size container. I was even telling friends how much I loved it. It was alarming, and I couldn’t figure out what was causing the problem. I found out about the papaya enzymes from another Sephora review and it all made sense.I am replacing this balm with another balm in my skincare routine because the exfoliation is too much for me on a daily basis. I wanted to write this review and warn others that this product is not just a makeup removing balm, it’s also a gentle exfoliant that may be too drying when paired with another cleanser or used daily. I’m giving this balm a low score because it should be very clear on the product label/packaging that it has an exfoliant, and I honestly had no idea. I don’t like when products aren’t clear about all of their purposes or try to do too much at once, and this is a perfect example. If you are looking for an exfoliating balm, you will probably like this product. If you simply want a balm to gently and easily remove makeup/SPF and/or to use as a part of a double cleanse, I would look elsewhere.

review_text: First, I would like to mention that I received the Dr. Dennis Gross Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel as a free sample from PINCHme. For my trial, I completed one treatment every other day before I went to bed for a week (3 treatments total), then monitored my skin the next week to look for lasting changes. For reference, my skin is normally pretty dry, with occasional hormonal acne, large pores around my nose , fine lines on forehead and around eyes and mouth, and mild sensitivity. I think it’s important to note that I wore a SPF 30 moisturizer cream every morning. I broke down each claim of the product and whether or not I felt I experienced the advertised effect to best analyze my thoughts on it.  Signs of Aging: Because I tried it for such a short time that may be why I saw no change. Acne: No immediate change. After one week the little bit of acne I had at the start has completely cleared up , so this would probably be a great product for someone who has a General mild to moderate acne. Enlarged Pores: No immediate change. Very slight change after a week of using them but nothing huge. Though I did notice that makeup did not enhance the pores as it used to. Dry Skin: Skin seems tight but easily remedied with my daily spf moisturizer.

review_text: My first time using this product. It is thick syrupy a small amount to clean your face goes a long way.
